QuestInfo.name: Finding Sophia
QuestInfo.1: In Lith Harbor, you meet a heavily-bearded crewmember of The Victoria called Teo. He says he has some #bWeird Medicine#k but he isn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he says he'll trade it for a #bsparkling rock#k. He seems like he knows Maya pretty well, yet he still wants a favor first, knowing how sick Maya is? Creep. Anyway, to get the #bsparkling rock#k, you should head to Perion and talk to #rSophia#k, the daughter of the owner of the General Store there.
QuestInfo.2: You met Sophia. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs #bArcon's blood#k.

0.0: Well, I do happen to have some #b#t4031006##k, but I can't give it to you for free. Hmm, if you get me a #b#t4031004##k, though, I may reconsider...meaning I would be willing to trade with you.
0.1: Want to know how to get that stone? I wouldn't be asking for your help if I knew! Here's the deal, head over to the general store in #b#m102000000##k, ask for the daughter of the owner, #r#p1022100##k, and ask her about its whereabouts. She may have a clue...
0.2: You know how to get to #m102000000#, don't you? You can get there by going through the Six Path Crossway. Sorry, was that too obvious?

npc.0: Didn't get the #b#t4031004##k yet? Oh well, it's not the easiest things to acquire. Ah, so gorgeous when it shines like a star... Hurry and go see #r#p1022100##k at the general store in #b#m102000000##k.
